title: Reliance on trust instrument.
bodyText: A trustee who acts in reasonable reliance on the terms of the trust as expressed in the trust instrument shall not be liable to a beneficiary for a breach of trust to the extent the breach resulted from the reliance.
bodyHtml: [§554D-1006]  Reliance on trust instrument.  A trustee who acts in reasonable reliance on the terms of the trust as expressed in the trust instrument shall not be liable to a beneficiary for a breach of trust to the extent the breach resulted from the reliance. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
